section: Investigation of adenosine as a leveling additive with synergetic acceleration–suppression behavior for superconformal cobalt filling in X-shaped through-hole > ABSTRACT
text: Adenosine (ADO) was selected as a leveling additive for superconformal cobalt filling in X-shaped through-hole. Changes in deposition potential and the generation of new stripping peaks in cyclic voltammetry curves were observed in electrochemical tests of ADO-containing plating solution. The adsorption behavior of ADO on the cobalt surface was investigated using density functional theory calculations, molecular dynamics (MD) simulation, and electrochemical in situ Fourier transform infrared (E-FTIR) spectroscopy tests.
